corrections.listSub: What the regulator sends and what the register now holds, one row per corrected value.
corrections.footnote: Ahead means an approved NPC value that differs from what the regulator currently sends, on a field that regulator supplies. When the regulator starts sending the same value it moves to caught up. Not counted yet: contacts, one-off migration loads, and employment (it comes from registers, not regulators).

sampling.title: Sample Builder
sampling.description: Define a population, split it into random, full and hand-picked groups, draw a reproducible sample, then export it with establishments and contacts
sampling.noAccess: You do not have access to the Sample Builder.
sampling.loadError: The Sample Builder could not load. Please try again.
sampling.step1Sub: Draw from the live register, or from a frozen frame so the same draw can be repeated later. Enterprises are sampled; every establishment of a drawn enterprise comes with it.
sampling.step2Sub: Which units can be sampled. Combine conditions with AND / OR, nest groups, exclude a group.
sampling.step3Sub: Split the population into random, full and hand-picked groups. A unit is in one group only: hand-picked first, then full, then random, each in list order.
sampling.step4Sub: How many units each random group takes from each of its strata. Full and hand-picked groups take every unit.
sampling.step5Sub: Simple random sampling within each stratum. The same seed on the same frame and design always gives the same units.
sampling.liveWarning: The live register changes every day: the same seed will not give the same units tomorrow.
sampling.applyFirst: Count the groups and strata (step 3) first.
sampling.tooManyUnits: At most {{n}} units in one draw.
sampling.applyBeforeDraw: The population or groups changed: count them again (step 3) before drawing.
sampling.drawnSummary: {{main}} main and {{reserve}} reserve units ({{units}}) from {{frame}}, seed {{seed}}.
sampling.drawStale: The design changed since this draw: draw again to export.
sampling.drawError: The sample could not be drawn. Please try again.
sampling.exportError: The workbook could not be built. Please try again.
sampling.designLoaded: Design loaded. Count the groups to continue.
sampling.designInvalid: That file is not a Sample Builder design.
sampling.strataError: The groups could not be counted. Please try again.
sampling.emptyGroup: Empty group: ignored until it has a condition.
sampling.bandsError: Numbers, each larger than the one before
sampling.noStrataHint: No strata: one simple random sample from the whole group.
sampling.everyValueStratum: Every distinct value becomes a stratum
sampling.auxHint: Its spread in each stratum drives the Neyman allocation and the expected precision.
sampling.neymanNeedsAux: Neyman allocation needs an auxiliary field (step 3); without one it is proportional.
sampling.cvUnreachable: This precision cannot be reached (no auxiliary field, or a stratum left unsampled): showing a census.

warn.fixedExceedSize: Take-all and hand-set strata alone exceed the sample size, so the other strata get only their minimum.
warn.minimumsExceedSize: The minimum per stratum alone exceeds the sample size, so the sample is larger than asked.
warn.noVariance: The auxiliary field has no spread to allocate on, so Neyman fell back to proportional allocation.
warn.sizeAboveFrame: The sample size is above the population: every unit is taken.

sampling.pooledSd: Too few values: the size-weighted average SD of the other strata is used
sampling.setN: Units to sample in this stratum

export.expectedCv: Expected CV of the auxiliary total
export.methodText: Simple random sampling without replacement within each stratum, ordered by an MD5 hash of the seed and the unit id; reserve units follow the main units in that order. Full-population and hand-picked units are taken whole, at weight 1.
export.designJson: Design (load it in the Sample Builder)
export.designTooLong: Too long for a cell: use "Save design" on the page.
